audit_result.proof_trace: addRoleToMember and removeRoleFromMember (utils/discord.ts L90-117) catch all Discord API errors and return false rather than throwing; syncRoles never checks these return values (L51, L64), so any Discord API failure silently leaves the member with 0 or 2+ generation roles while the endpoint returns HTTP 200 success:true. Additionally, when generationRole is null (member's DB generation has no matching generation_roles row), the entire sync block is skipped and pre-existing incorrect generation roles are never removed, violating the count==1 postcondition.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker whose account triggers a Discord API error (e.g., bot permission revocation, rate-limit) during syncRoles can retain stale or multiple generation roles while the system confirms success, bypassing intended single-role enforcement.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-post-001.text: After syncRoles, member must have exactly one generation role assigned.
